item.content:encoded: You’ll have to get used to it: yet another week filled with AI content. From MCPs to Agent Skills to AI-specific CLIs, we don’t know where to turn anymore.By the way, we’d love your feedback — what do you like about the newsletter, and how could we make it better in 2026?Just hit reply and let us know! ❤️As always, thanks for supporting us on your favorite platform:Make React apps fast where it actually matters.An advanced performance course from , focused on diagnosing real bottlenecks and fixing slow, janky React apps using modern React 19 patterns.🚀 : Suspense, transitions, deferred values, hydration, server actions🔍 : Find unnecessary re-renders with React DevTools & the Profiler🧠 : Memoization, virtualization, code splitting, optimistic UI⚡ : Learn how React Fiber prioritizes work to keep apps responsive⏱ 4+ hours • ⭐ 4.8 ratingNotion, Dropbox and LaunchDarkly have found a new testing paradigm - and they can't imagine working without it. Built by ex-Palantir engineers, Meticulous autonomously creates a continuously evolving suite of E2E UI tests that delivers near-exhaustive coverage with - impossible to deliver by any other means. It works like magic in the background:Near-exhaustive coverage on every test runNo maintenance (seriously)Zero flakes (built on a deterministic browser)Worklets have been extracted from Reanimated to become a first-class multithreading primitive. It has been integrated into the upcoming VisionCamera V5, enabling its real-time frame processor system to run directly on the Camera Thread.Also, take a look at 📦 Worklets 0.8 - Bundle Mode preview. It makes it possible to use third-party libraries and do network requests within worklets. This mode is opt-in but might become the default in the future.
